transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in. Can you tell me what’s been going on that brought you here today?

Well… I guess I’ve just been having a rough time, and I didn’t want to make a big deal out of it. But I started having thoughts like maybe my family would be better off if I just didn’t wake up. I’m not proud of saying that. It scared me enough that I told my supervisor, and they thought I should come talk to someone.
How long have you been feeling this way? Has it been more than two weeks, or started recently?
It’s been… about two weeks, I’d say. Since my daughter left Georgia for the military, that’s when I noticed I wasn’t really myself. I don’t know if that sounds right, but it’s been around then.
Have you ever felt this way before, like you weren’t yourself or had thoughts of not wanting to wake up?

Yeah… I mean, not exactly like this, or I tried not to think of it that way. Looking back, I guess I’ve had low stretches coming around for maybe about a year now. I just kind of pushed through them. But this time, after my daughter left, it’s been the hardest one.
Before this most recent episode, have you ever had a time when you felt down or lost interest in things for a period of at least two weeks?

Yeah… I think so. I mean, I didn’t really call it that at the time, but looking back, I’ve had these low stretches off and on for about a year. I tried to just keep going and not make much of it. This one after my daughter left, though, it’s been the hardest.

Before this current episode that started around two weeks ago, have you ever had another period lasting at least two weeks where you felt down or lost interest in things most of the day, nearly every day?

Yeah… I think so. I don’t want to make it sound worse than it was, but looking back, those low stretches have been coming around for maybe about a year. I’d usually just try to get through them. This one, since my daughter left, just hit me the hardest.
Before this current episode, have you had more than one other time in the past year when you felt down or lost interest in things for at least two weeks?

Yeah… I think more than once, if I’m being honest. I didn’t really keep count, and I tried to tell myself it was just being tired or having a rough patch, you know? But looking back, those low stretches have been coming around for about a year. This one after my daughter left has definitely hit me the hardest.

Before this current episode, have you had at least two separate times in the past where you felt down or lost interest in things for at least a couple of weeks, with a clear period of improvement in between?

Yeah… I think that’s right. I mean, I didn’t really mark it down or anything, but looking back, those low stretches have been showing up for about a year now, with times in between where I was doing better. This one after my daughter left, though, that’s the one that’s felt the hardest.
Before this most recent episode, did you ever have a time when you were so down or lost interest in things that it affected your ability to function at work, home, or other important areas of life?

Yeah… I mean, I guess it did, more than I wanted to admit. At work I was making mistakes, and it got bad enough that one morning my supervisor found me sitting in my truck before dawn. They ended up getting occupational health involved.

And at home… I’ve let bills and things pile up, stuff I normally would’ve handled. I’m not proud of that. I kept trying to tell myself I was just tired or behind, but… yeah, it was affecting things.
